== English Decipher comparison ==
The 2011 PC wording narrows deployment to an opponent's card and keeps capture by a bounty hunter. The 2017 PC wording requires seizure by a bounty hunter after capture. The Dungeon transfer, forfeit-based retrieval, Han bonus and Alter immunity stay the same.

Players Committee, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1119161#p1119161 Hutt Bounty replacement wording], 18 May 2017. Players Committee, June 2017, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/a/a0/PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf#page=8 Decipher Errata slips], PDF page 8. Players Committee, 2023, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/3/3d/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=116 Advanced Rulebook, Appendix A], PDF page 116. Earlier wording: Players Committee, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=623187#p623187 Hutt Bounty errata], 20 May 2011. Players Committee, Decipher Errata, official text as of 1 January 2013, PDF page 8.
